Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: C2 kernel-basis/condition-profile structural v2 identity is on main, but ObservedFamilyCertification.geometry still interpolates raw onset/duration/precision values and ProfileHrfFit profile-fit/v2 still interpolates budget/lambda/config. Their JVM/JS identity drift remains. Custom unsealed family identity and unreachable trial-axis identity caveats are distinct related limits.

Fresh context: Yes: current identity defect.

Next action: Reuse the delivered Hrf/KernelBasis/ConditionProfile/ResponsePreparation encoders with an explicit geometry/profile-fit version bump and shared exact JVM/JS goldens. Decide custom-family structural identity separately; do not declare C2 landing a complete identity repair.

Evidence: ObservedFamilyCertification.scala:350; ProfileHrfFit.scala:764; C2 review note; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Found during C2 (provenance v2) readiness. ObservedFamilyAdmission.geometry embeds onsets, TR, precision, whitening, nuisance as raw Double toString; ProfileHrfFit 'profile-fit/v2' embeds decode=${policy.budget} (default toString), lambda, grid, config. JVM renders 24.0 vs JS 24, so these strings differ across platforms. In-process only today (each platform self-consistent). Fix: move to the HrfIdentity encoding (bits:, length-prefixed, tagged records, decode-budget/v1) with a version bump and shared JVM+JS goldens, as C2 did for kernel-basis/condition-profile.
